subject.title: feat(android): add Wear conversations, voice, agents, and sessions

question: Should OpenClaw land this full conversation-capable Wear OS companion, or stage the status-only companion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108803 first?
rationale: The merged protocol establishes the phone-proxy boundary, but the two open branches represent materially different feature, release, compatibility, and proof commitments.

options.title: Stage status first
options.body: Land the narrower status-only companion and review conversations, voice, TTS, agents, sessions, and release publication as bounded follow-ups.

options.title: Land full companion
options.body: Retain this branch as the landing candidate after its defects, exact-head proof gap, release checks, and Android-owner review are resolved.

recommendation.title: Stage status first
recommendation.body: Land the narrower status-only companion and review conversations, voice, TTS, agents, sessions, and release publication as bounded follow-ups.
